name: StepFlow
description: A stepped-flow ENGINE (useStepFlow + StepFlow* slot primitives) that wears the design's own markup — panels, answer cards, counter words, whichever nav the frame draws. Ships no look: what you copy is mechanics, and the starting markup is skeleton.quiz.tsx / skeleton.stepper.tsx.
whenToUse: Designs that walk the reader through a SEQUENCE one panel at a time. Author the frame's OWN markup and drive it with useStepFlow + the primitives: StepFlowPanel per step, StepFlowOption asChild makes the design's card the whole answer control (real radio underneath), StepFlowProgress is a render prop over the design's own counter words, StepFlowBack/StepFlowNext exist only where the frame draws them — and when no Next is mounted, picking an answer IS the advance (after a beat that shows the verdict). StepFlowResult is the ending: the author's markup over { score, answers, restart }, or mount a native form inside it (with StepFlowAnswerFields) and the ending is a capture per the host's form contract. A design that drew NO quiz or stepper UI of its own still starts from the skeleton — choose the panel, the counter wording and the nav yourself and style them in the kit's tokens; there is no styled component to fall back to, because the copy carries no look. NOT for panels the reader opens in any order (Accordion or Tabs) or a horizontal gallery (Carousel).

implements.note: START FROM skeleton.stepper.tsx beside this file: copy it into a section, reshape every element and class to the design, keep the hook and primitives. The design decides which nav exists (reachability: with no Next drawn, advancing is the reader's own gesture).

START FROM skeleton.quiz.tsx beside this file: copy it into a section, reshape every element and class to the design, keep the hook and primitives. StepFlowOption asChild makes the design's answer cards the controls (verdicts arrive as data-state), no Next mounted means answering advances after the verdict beat, and the ending is a decision — plain result, or the skeleton's commented capture form (StepFlowAnswerFields carries the answers) per the host's form contract.
